_about: Measured 2026-10-09 with composer_probe(steps=...) on the German interface: self-made single-colour PNGs uploaded, editors opened and read, composer discarded, nothing published. Anonymised: names, ids and URLs are placeholders. English interface not measured.

member_composer.content_types: 'Inhaltsarten einblenden' offers only 'Event' and 'Stellenanzeige' -- no document
member_composer.author_button: a button reading the member's name (not measured further)
member_composer.after_next: composer shows one blob: preview per image (374x281) plus buttons 'Edit' and 'Close' (English wording on a German interface); 'Posten' enabled; no progress indicator

member_editor.toggle_state: aria-pressed='false' on Bearbeiten/Tag/Alternativer Text, also after an alt text was saved
member_editor.selection: the selected thumbnail is the one whose 'nach links'/'nach rechts' button is disabled at the edge

alt_dialog.textarea_placeholder: Wie würden Sie dieses Bild beschreiben?

tag_dialog.options: role=option, not inside a listbox; title + '1. · <headline>' or '<company> Firma· <industry>'
tag_dialog.option_identity: React prop id='mentionTypeahead_display_<entityID>' (as in the mention typeahead)
tag_dialog.after_pick: chip button with the name + checkbox; 'Hinzufügen' enabled

page_composer.after_next: composer shows 'Bildvorschau' data: previews, 'Medienvorschau bearbeiten', 'Medieninhalt entfernen', 'Posten' enabled

alt_dialog.textarea_placeholder: Wie würden Sie dieses Bild beschreiben?

tag_dialog.options: role=option inside role=listbox; '<name> 1. · <headline>' or '<company> Unternehmen · <industry>'; the signed-in member first ('Sie')

page_editor.tag_identity: no identifier on the options (no attribute, no framework props)

identity_switch.measured_on: a post of the administered page, opened from /company/<page id>/posts/ (an upsell modal had to be dismissed first)
identity_switch.comment_box: div[role=textbox][aria-label='Texteditor zum Erstellen von Kommentaren'] with Emoji, GIF and 'Foto teilen' -- no 'Kommentieren als' / actor control
identity_switch.reaction: 'Status des Reaktionsbuttons: Keine Reaktion' and 'Menü mit Reaktionen öffnen' -- no 'reagieren als' control
